<js>
var responseText=String(result==null?"":result).trim();
function parseResponse(text){
  text=String(text||"").trim();
  if(text.charAt(0)!=="{"&&text.charAt(0)!=="["){
    var start=text.indexOf("{");
    var end=text.lastIndexOf("}");
    if(start>=0&&end>start)text=text.substring(start,end+1);
  }
  try{return JSON.parse(text);}catch(error){return null;}
}
var body=parseResponse(responseText);
if(!body&&String(baseUrl||"").indexOf("/yyting/musicradio/channelPage")>=0){
  
  body=parseResponse(String(java.ajax(lrtsUrl(java,source,"/yyting/musicradio/channelPage",{hv:"1.434.0"}))));
}
if(!body){java.log("懒人听书发现响应不是 JSON: "+responseText.substring(0,120));body={};}
var list=[];
var seen={};
function add(raw){
  if(!raw)return;
  if(raw.ranking&&Array.isArray(raw.ranking.list)){raw.ranking.list.forEach(add);return;}
  if(raw.musicList&&Array.isArray(raw.musicList.list)){raw.musicList.list.forEach(add);return;}
  if(raw.folder&&Array.isArray(raw.folder.list)){raw.folder.list.forEach(add);return;}
  if(raw.videoCollectionManga||raw.activity||raw.topic||raw.advert)return;
  if(Number(raw.type)===10000)return;
  if(raw.bookAlbum)raw=raw.bookAlbum;
  if(raw.music)raw=raw.music;
  if(raw.entityId&&raw.entityName)raw={id:raw.entityId,name:raw.entityName,cover:raw.cover,typeName:raw.typeName,score:raw.score,playCount:raw.playCount,recReason:raw.highlightTags||"",entityType:1};
  if(raw.songMid)raw={id:String(raw.songMid),name:raw.songName,author:raw.singerName,announcer:raw.singerName,cover:raw.pic,desc:raw.albumName,entityType:99,_music:1,mediaMid:raw.mediaMid};
  var itemType=Number(raw.type);
  if(itemType===19||itemType===80||itemType===10||itemType===63||itemType===10000)return;
  var id=raw.id||raw.entityId||raw.baseEntityId;
  var displayName=raw.name||raw.entityName||raw.realName||raw.songName;
  if(!id||!displayName||seen[String(id)])return;
  var entityType=Number(raw.entityType||raw.baseEntityType||1);
  if(entityType!==1&&entityType!==99)return;
  raw.id=String(id);
  raw.name=String(displayName);
  raw.cover=raw.cover||raw.bestCover||raw.orignCover||raw.dynamicCover||"";
  raw.announcer=raw.announcer||raw.nickName||"";
  raw.author=raw.author||"";
  seen[String(id)]=1;
  list.push(raw);
}
if(body.data&&body.data.bookAlbums){
  var searchBooks=body.data.bookAlbums||[];
  var previousRefer=String(source.get("lrts_search_refer")||"");
  var nextRefer=String(body.data.tabInfo&&body.data.tabInfo.referId||"");
  source.put("lrts_search_refer",(!searchBooks.length||!nextRefer||nextRefer===previousRefer)?"end":nextRefer);
  searchBooks.forEach(add);
}else if(body.books){
  if(body.bookIds&&body.bookIds.length>20) source.put("lrts_book_ids",body.bookIds.join(","));
  body.books.concat(body.albums||[]).forEach(add);
}else if(body.list){
  if(String(baseUrl||"").indexOf("/yyting/read/rankingsItemList.action")>=0){
    var rankMatch=String(baseUrl||"").match(/[?&]rankId=([^&]+)/);
    var rankKey="lrts_read_rank_"+(rankMatch?decodeURIComponent(rankMatch[1]):"");
    var previous=String(source.get(rankKey)||"0");
    var next=body.list.length?String(body.list[body.list.length-1].showOrder||""):"";
    source.put(rankKey,!next||next===previous?"end":next);
  }else{
    body.list.forEach(add);
  }
}else if(body.data){
  var data=body.data;
  if(data.recommendEntityList){
    source.put("lrts_feed_refer",String(data.referId||"end"));
    data.recommendEntityList.forEach(add);
  }
  (data.rankListModule||[]).forEach(function(module){(module.list||[]).forEach(add);});
  (data.ranking&&data.ranking.rankings||[]).forEach(function(rank){(rank.rankingItems||[]).forEach(add);});
  if(data.list&&data.list.length)data.list.forEach(add);
  function modules(groups){(groups||[]).forEach(function(group){(group.moduleList||[]).forEach(function(module){(module.entityList||[]).forEach(add);});});}
  modules(data.moduleGroup);
  (data.channelGroup||[]).forEach(function(channel){modules(channel.moduleGroup);});
  var tabId=String(source.get("lrts_music_tab")||"");
  (data.tabList||[]).filter(function(tab){return !tabId||String(tab.id)===tabId;}).forEach(function(tab){(tab.musicList||[]).forEach(add);});
  (data.musicList||[]).forEach(add);
}
result=JSON.stringify(list);
</js>

<js>
var raw=String(result==null?"":result);
if(String(baseUrl||"").indexOf("/yyting/bookclient/ClientGetBookResource.action")>=0){
  var catalogBody;
  try{catalogBody=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(error){throw new Error("听书目录响应不是 JSON: "+error);}
  if(Number(catalogBody.status)!==0||!Array.isArray(catalogBody.list)){
    throw new Error(String(catalogBody.msg||"听书目录响应缺少 list"));
  }
  var responseBookId=String(catalogBody.bookId||"");
  if(!responseBookId)throw new Error("听书目录响应缺少 bookId");
  catalogBody.list.forEach(function(item){
    if(item&&typeof item==="object"){
      item._lrtsBookId=responseBookId;
      item._lrtsEntityType="1";
    }
  });
  result=JSON.stringify(catalogBody);
}else{
  var musicBody;
  try{musicBody=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(error){throw new Error("歌曲目录响应不是 JSON: "+error);}
  var musicList=Array.isArray(musicBody)?musicBody:
    (Array.isArray(musicBody.list)?musicBody.list:
    (Array.isArray(musicBody.data)?musicBody.data:
    (musicBody.data?[musicBody.data]:[])));
  result=JSON.stringify({list:musicList});
}
result;
</js>

	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
